original_goal:
[Module: Accounts Overview | TC-008 | Type: Negative | Priority: High]
Title: Unauthenticated access to Accounts Overview redirects to Login

▶ Start URL:    http://localhost:8080/accounts-overview
▶ Requires Auth: No
▶ Test Data:
{
  "accounts_url": "http://localhost:8080/accounts-overview",
  "login_url": "http://localhost:8080/login",
  "username": "admin"
}

Preconditions:
  User is not authenticated. If the user is currently signed in, sign out before starting the test.

Steps to Execute:
  1. If currently signed in, click 'Sign Out' to log out
  2. Navigate directly to the Accounts Overview URL: http://localhost:8080/accounts-overview
  3. Observe whether the user is redirected to the Login page (http://localhost:8080/login) and confirm the Accounts Table and Welcome message are not visible

Expected Result:
  Access is blocked; user is redirected to the Login page (http://localhost:8080/login); Accounts Table and Welcome message are not visible.

Notes from prior verification:
  Added an explicit Sign Out step to ensure the precondition (unauthenticated user) is satisfied before navigating to the Accounts Overview. The verification snapshot indicated the session was authenticated, so this step is required to make the test reproducible.
expected_outcome: Access is blocked; user is redirected to the Login page (http://localhost:8080/login); Accounts Table and Welcome message are not visible.
